note: Three rule-chosen demonstration points (not candidate sites) and twelve named south-polar places. The named places are the IAU's official centre points: a crater centre is its floor, not its rim, and NASA's Artemis III regions are 15 km areas on or near these features, so none of these is a landing recommendation. Real candidate sites would need their own provenance (SDR-001 D-09).
